text:
support-elena: FYI Terrana reported a sharp p95 jump and occasional timeouts against their Dedicated cluster since last deploy. seeing spikes from ~180ms -> 800-1200ms. can runtime take a look?

kiran: tagging runtime triage. do we have a rollback window or can we run a scoped probe first? @marta any immediate ideas?

marta: I can look. do we have the request ids or a dashboard link?

support-elena: dashboard: https://console.redwood/tenants/terrana/overview -> traces show p95 up around 2026-03-17T10:12Z. sample trace id: trace-0b9f. attaching a short sample log snippet from their dedicated agent: `2026-03-17T10:12:14Z WARN request_id=9a3f latency=1104ms model=gpt-small variant=q4\n`

kiran: thanks. ops-bot: last deploy?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: service=tenant-terrana-runtime image=runtime:v1.12.3 at 2026-03-17T09:58:21Z by ci-release

sam: if deploy was at 09:58 and spike at 10:12 that narrows it. could be a kernel selector/quant change in v1.12.3. can someone run a quick perf probe on a repro route?

lucas: I can run a 60s load test from staging edge to the dedicated pool with our stress script. which endpoint and headers to use?

marta: use the same route that Terrana reported: `POST /v1/generate` body size ~350 tokens, concurrency 8, repeat 200. include header `X-Tenant: terrana`.

lucas: running now. command I use: 
```bash
./tools/stress.sh --url https://dedicated.terrana.redwood/api/v1/generate \\n  --concurrency 8 --requests 200 --body examples/350tok.json \\n  --headers 'X-Tenant: terrana'
```

lucas: quick results: p50 210ms p95 980ms errors 2 timeouts. collecting pprof from one of the runtime hosts now (will attach).

marta: can you also capture the runtime metrics around batching and kvcache hits? on the host run: `curl localhost:9090/metrics | grep -E "batch|kvcache"` and drop the output here.

lucas: metrics: `runtime_batch_size_avg 3.6\nruntime_batch_wait_ms_p95 18\nkvcache_hit_rate 0.02`

kiran: kvcache hit rate 2% is suspiciously low. Terrana's workload should be steady prefixes. did the deploy change cache key format or disable prefix caching?

marta: looking at v1.12.3 changelog—there's a change that skips KV caching for requests with `X-Trace-Id` header to avoid key collisions. support-elena: does Terrana set trace ids per request?

support-elena: they do set a unique trace id every request (client side). that explains low kvcache hits. but why did this only surface now? previous runtime version tolerated it by using a weaker key.

kiran: hypothesis: v1.12.3 tightened the cache key (includes trace header) which invalidates prefix reuse. mitigation options: rollback to v1.12.2, patch to ignore trace headers in the cache key, or enable a tenant-level cache override.

sam: short-term: I can trigger a rollback on the Terrana pool to v1.12.2 (30-minute window) to confirm. long-term: patch is preferable.

marta: before rollback, can we try a targeted config flip to re-enable legacy cache key behavior? it's less invasive than full rollback. requires a config change on the pool: `runtime.cache.key_mode=legacy`. who can flip?

lucas: I can flip on one canary host in the pool and re-run stress. will do and report.

lucas: canary flip complete on host host-terr-03; re-running 60s stress -> p95 now 230ms p50 200ms errors 0. kvcache_hit_rate 68%.

support-elena: Terrana confirmed latency regressions decreased after you flipped the canary. they want a full fix and postmortem.

kiran: action items: 
- lucas: roll the legacy key_mode across the pool as an emergency short-term mitigation (please coordinate with infra, do a rolling change).
- marta: open a PR to avoid including `X-Trace-Id` in cache keys and add a feature flag + tests.
- sam: prepare rollback playbook in case mitigation fails; coordinate with Support for customer comms.
- support-elena: collect Terrana acceptance and confirm SLA status.

marta: PR draft will include unit tests and a canary rollout plan. target for code PR in ~2 hours.

lucas: starting rolling apply now, will post progress.

ops-bot: Rolling config change initiated: runtime.cache.key_mode=legacy -> target=pool-terrana by lucas at 2026-03-17T11:02Z

lucas: rolled to 4/7 hosts, p95 trending down on each as it hits.

kiran: thanks team. let's keep updates here; we'll collect logs/pprof artifacts and attach to the postmortem. add any follow-ups and I'll schedule a 30-min async review later today. :thumbsup:

support-elena: thanks everyone — I'll update Terrana and hold until full fix is shipped.
